blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—With Jacob Cortez still sidelined with a right knee injury, La Salle turned to its rookie Joaquin Tovera in a crucial rivalry game against Ateneo in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament. Tovera delivered and led the Green Archers to a thrilling 76-73 overtime win for their third straight victory. He shone with 21 points, seven rebounds and six assists as La Salle rose to third with a 6-4 record. Tovera said he didn’t see his role as someone who’s filling in for Cortez.
